historical_record.description: The 15,000-square-foot corner, 137 feet on Clay and Merchant Streets and about 109 on Montgomery, held two office buildings and a hotel of three and four storeys, all with shops on the ground floor and vacant above it.
The City Planning Commission voted 5 to 1 to approve a nineteen-storey, 254-foot office building with ground-floor shops and a Montgomery Street arcade on the corner (Resolution 7824).
